name: lequ-life-platform
description: 乐趣生活 V5.0 全平台 Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lequ/api && npm run build:h5 -w @lequ/mobile && npm run build:miniapps && npm run build -w @lequ/admin-web
scripts.build:miniapps: npm run build:h5 -w @lequ/consumer-miniapp && npm run build:h5 -w @lequ/merchant-miniapp && npm run build:h5 -w @lequ/sales-miniapp && npm run build:h5 -w @lequ/provider-miniapp
scripts.build:weixin: npm run build:mp-weixin -w @lequ/consumer-miniapp && npm run build:mp-weixin -w @lequ/merchant-miniapp && npm run build:mp-weixin -w @lequ/sales-miniapp && npm run build:mp-weixin -w @lequ/provider-miniapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lequ/auth && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/product-catalog && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/api && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/mobile && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/consumer-miniapp && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/merchant-miniapp && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/sales-miniapp && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/provider-miniapp && npm run typecheck -w @lequ/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lequ/auth && npm run test -w @lequ/product-catalog && npm run test -w @lequ/api && npm run test -w @lequ/merchant-miniapp && npm run test -w @lequ/admin-web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
